description: Hooks for the no-code-method plugin. SessionStart injects the universal behavioural rules at session start (and on resume/clear/compact). PreToolUse enforces read-only on locked source-of-truth docs (UX.md and any additional SoT docs declared in the project's CLAUDE.md path block). UserPromptSubmit was the original choice for SessionStart's job but is blocked by anthropics/claude-code#10225; SessionStart works in plugins today and is functionally equivalent given the method's /clear-after-every-build discipline.
